source_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) programs, following 2007 World Health Organization (WHO) recommendations, target HIV prevention in high-prevalence sub-Saharan Africa regions, where randomized controlled trials show approximately 60% reduction in heterosexual HIV acquisition among circumcised men.
